$comment: 0.3.x to 0.4.0 custom-property renames. Consumed by scripts/codemod-tokens.mjs and published in the CHANGELOG. Order is irrelevant: the codemod matches whole property names, so no rename can partially rewrite another.

--yl-color-brand.why: The literal equivalent, and the wrong answer wherever the value was colouring text. `brand-primary` is #1A7FE2, which is 4.06:1 on white and fails the WCAG AA text threshold; that is the defect two consumers reported independently. It remains correct for decoration, which only has to clear 3:1.

use-instead.--yl-color-fg-brand: text that should look branded; a step darker, 5.38:1
use-instead.--yl-color-fg-link: an anchor, which has its own role and hover state
use-instead.--yl-color-interactive-bg: the fill of a control, such as accent-color or a checked switch

new.$comment: Tokens that did not exist before. Nothing to rename; listed so a consumer can see what is now available rather than discovering it by grep.
new.type-scale: --yl-text-<role>-{family,size,weight,leading,tracking,transform} for hero, h1..h4, body-lg, body, body-sm, label, button, caption, code
new.status-accents: --yl-color-status-<kind>-solid, the accent on its own rather than as a bg/fg/border triad
